title: Ideal 8-bit ADC Model
constraints: `VREF` is a `real` parameter / generic, default `1.0` V.
`code = floor(vin / VREF * 256)`, clamped to the range 0 to 255.
`vin` is sampled on the rising edge of `clk` only. `code` is 0 before the first edge.
The model does not need to be synthesizable.
hints: SystemVerilog: `$floor()` returns a `real`. Convert it with `$rtoi()` after clamping.
VHDL: `floor`, `realmin` and `realmax` are in `ieee.math_real`. Clamp before `integer(...)`, or out-of-range values will overflow `to_unsigned`.
Put the conversion inside the clocked block, so `code` holds between edges.

examples.check: output only changes on the rising
examples.title: sample & hold
examples.input: code = 128, vin changes to 0.9 and 0.1 between edges
examples.expected: code stays 128 until the next rising edge, then 25
